title: Sins of the Father
start: Talk to Mr Mordaut, located at the Anachronia base camp, east of the Anachronia lodestone.

requirements.t:
85 Crafting or
85 Runecrafting or
85 Smithing or
85 Invention

rewards.t: Access to Effigy Incubator Distraction and Diversion

steps.t: Talk to Mr Mordaut at the Anachronia base camp. [Chat: 1 Anachronia. › 1 Talk about Kerapac. › Accept]
Talk to either Eliza or Alpheus south of the lodestone. [Chat: 1 Talk about Kerapac. (Sins of the Father)]
Exit Anachronia base camp to the north down the stairs, not via the Agility shortcut.
Continue north up the first set of stairs and investigate the bottom part of the dragonkin statue to your immediate west.

sub.t: If a message appears telling you to complete this very quest, go back to the open area between the two flights of stairs (by the entrance to Kerapac's laboratory until you trigger a dialogue about something "out of place".
You must also trigger another dialogue in front of the statue itself about the statue looking different before you can enter the statue.

p: The effigy resources in the laboratory.

steps.t: Talk to Vicendithas [Chat: 2 What are you doing here? › 2 Can I help with the machine? › 1 Play tutorial.].
Collect an effigy casing from the middle.
Collect 20 resources from one of the nodes.

sub.t: A chat box will appear. Confirm it or you won't be able to continue dialogue with Vicendithas.

steps.t: Talk to Vicendithas. You need atleast 2 free inventory spaces.
Go to Kerapac's workbench and construct the effigy.
Turn the valves in the order instructed.
Interact with the incubator hatch to deposit the effigy.
Interact with the incubator hatch again.
Talk to Vicendithas again after ending the tutorial.
